definitions: To have someone completely under one's control or power.
To have a firm grip or strong influence over someone, often implying a coercive or dominant position.
examples: The boss had him by the short and curlies after that mistake.
She knew how to get things done; she had the whole team by the short and curlies.
Once the scandal broke, the media had the politician by the short and curlies.
synonyms: by the scruff of the neck
